cases.name: Diane Brown
cases.narrative: On 1/18/1981, her legs were found in a trash bag near Summit Ave & East Ave in Rancho Cucamonga, CA. On 01/26/1981, Diane's torso was found in a similar trash bag in the south Chino area. On 02/28/1981, Diane's head was found about 1/3 mile from where her legs were found, in Rancho Cucamonga, CA.

cases.name: Veronica Lopez
cases.about: The youngest of five daughters, Veronica Lopez always knew how to make people laugh, loved the 49ers, her boba drinks, her dogs and spending time with the people she loved, (her sister) Sabrina Lopez said. “She deserved the chance to grow, to live and to experience all the beautiful things life had in store for her,” Sabrina Lopez said. “Please remember her for the beautiful person she was, not for the tragedy that took her from us.”
